data.content:
Espen Garnas is sidelined long-term with a knee injury, while Camil Jebara, who is recovering from a groin injury, is doubtful for this clash.

On the other hand, Real Sociedad cruised to a comfortable 5-2 away win against Malaga on Sunday, bringing their unbeaten run across all competitions to three games.

The Basque side have been nothing short of impressive on the road, as they have no losses in their last four away games (W3, D1), scoring three goals on average during that stretch. [...] Like their opponents, Real Sociedad are without a win in two Europa League outings, having lost their opening game 2-1 at home against Bournemouth before playing out a 1-1 draw at Union Saint-Gilloise last Thursday.

Head coach Pellegrino Matarazzo will be missing several players for this trip, including Alvaro Odriozola (ACL), Luken Beitia (sprained ankle), Jon Aramburu (muscle), and Yangel Herrera (calf). [...] ## Whispers Predicts: Lillestrom 1-3 Real Sociedad

Priced at 11/20 (1.55), Real Sociedad are considered favourites by the bookies ahead of this skirmish.

The visitors have won three of their last four away games, and considering Lillestrom's recent struggles at home, we are confident that Real Sociedad will claim all the spoils here.

Six of Lillestrom's last eight matches and seven of Real Sociedad's last nine games have produced at least 11 corners, and this can be backed at 19/20 (1.95).

## Players to watch

Gonçalo Guedes has had a shot on target in four of his last five games and is 1.36 at bet365 to do it again. [...] Lillestrøm host Real Sociedad at Åråsen Stadion on Thursday 22 October, kick-off 8pm UK, in a Europa League league-stage game between two sides who have each taken one point from their first two matches. Both have a draw, a defeat and a goal difference of minus one, and the Norwegians sit 23rd in the table with Sociedad one place above them in 22nd. The gap between them is in the bookmakers' prices and in what has happened since: Sociedad arrive off a 5-2 win away at Málaga. [...] Real Sociedad are 22nd, level on a point after a 1-2 home loss to Bournemouth and a 1-1 draw at Union SG. Domestically they have been scoring freely, winning 5-2 at Málaga, 3-2 against Deportivo and 3-2 at Valencia in their last five. They have not kept a clean sheet in the Europa League this season and both teams have scored in every one of their games. Their shots on target average is 3 a game.
